display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Two lines: line one Ink, line two Editorial Indigo italic.

headline.purpose: Page-level section headlines. One italic key word per page maximum.

title.purpose: Project names, CTA statements. Playfair Display without italic.

body-lg.purpose: Subheadlines, service descriptions, about body. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: All-caps functional text: nav links, button text, section labels, form field labels.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered entrance for all content sections. GSAP ScrollTrigger.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: opacity 0→1, translateY 22px→0, duration 1s, ease power3.out, stagger 0.18s
motion.purpose: Hero content entrance on page load.

motion.name: image-hover
motion.purpose: Image scale on project/service card hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for View Project, Book a Consultation, Send Message, Get In Touch.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 15px 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: #4F46E5; color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #4F46E5; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3525CD; border-color: #3525CD; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Used alongside primary for lower-priority actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 15px 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #151C27; border: 1.5px solid #C7C4D8; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #151C27; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F46E5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Pill
components.description: Identity label above the hero headline. One use only per page.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid #C7C4D8; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #464555; } .ds-pill::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4F46E5; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: All-caps eyebrow label above page headlines. Signals the section name.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #777587; margin-bottom: 20px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed glass header. Identical across all 5 pages.
components.html:
Hallmark Studio
  • Work
  • Services
  • About
  • Contact
components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 72px; background: rgba(250,250,249,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav.scrolled { border-bottom-color: #E2E8F8; } .ds-nav__inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #151C27; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 36px; list-style: none; position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-nav__links a { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #464555; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: #151C27; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Contact form input. Bottom-border only — no enclosing box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #464555; } .ds-field__input { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: #151C27; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #C7C4D8; padding: 12px 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; width: 100%; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #777587; } .ds-field__input:focus { border-bottom-color: #151C27; }

narrative.overview:
Hallmark Studio is a new studio with complete conviction. The design system reflects that: restrained on the surface, sharp underneath. There are no gratuitous animations, no borrowed aesthetic frameworks, no signals borrowed from established agencies. This is a system that communicates authority through what it removes, not what it adds. Every surface that does not earn its presence is cut. The result is a visual language that feels inevitable rather than designed.

The system is built on a strict typographic hierarchy. Playfair Display carries the brand identity at every headline scale. Inter handles everything functional. The contrast between the two typefaces IS the personality of the studio. Color is restrained by doctrine. The palette is Parchment and Ink with one accent: Editorial Indigo. That accent is rationed, never decorative. Its rarity is its power.
keyCharacteristics: Typographic-first: the serif headline IS the identity, not decoration
Restrained color: near-monochromatic with one rationed indigo accent
Space as a design decision: generous vertical rhythm, no decorative fills
Flat elevation: no shadows, depth through tonal surface shifts only
Motion serves communication: scroll fades only, no choreography for its own sake

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Editorial Indigo appears on 15% or less of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Page backgrounds use Parchment (#FAFAF9), never #FFFFFF. Pure white is reserved for reversed text on indigo buttons only.

rules.name: The Italic Moment Rule
rules.body: Italic Playfair Display is used once per page, in the primary headline, for the phrase that carries the most semantic weight.

rules.name: The Caps Boundary Rule
rules.body: Uppercase text is strictly limited to the Label role. Headlines and body copy are sentence case.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Box shadows are prohibited site-wide. Depth is tonal.

dos: Do use Playfair Display italic for exactly one key phrase per page headline
Do keep Editorial Indigo to primary CTAs, italic headline spans, section indexes, and service tags only
Do use 1px Border Light (#E2E8F8) as the only structural separator
Do let white space carry weight — section gap is 120px
Do scale images on hover via transform: scale(1.025) only
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for all GSAP animations
donts: Don't use cursor blobs, excessive parallax, 3D WebGL, or any animation that performs effort rather than communicating
Don't use generic SaaS template structures: hero plus three-feature grid plus pricing table
Don't use dark neon or developer-tool aesthetics
Don't use stock photography: smiling team photos, iStock imagery, generic laptop filler
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left as a colored accent greater than 1px)
Don't use Editorial Indigo as a background fill or gradient
Don't use uppercase outside the Label typographic role
